GDX residual-reversal strategy — in-sample report

Summary

Status: hard_filters_disabled. Hard filters were disabled for this run: the shortlist is the top configs by neighbourhood score and the primary is the best by validation Sharpe + neighbourhood rank. Filter results are shown for information only; the primary fails f_months, f_halves, f_years, f_ex_top_days on validation, so it does not meet every stated requirement (e.g. at least one trade per month).

Primary: GLD+TLT|L250|m3|k1.25|H1|N|rev   alternates: SPY+GLD|L250|m3|k1.25|H1|N|rev, SPY+GLD+TLT|L250|m3|k1.25|H1|N|rev

  • Development net Sharpe 0.27 (neighbourhood median 0.70); validation net Sharpe -0.20. Validation failed filters: f_months, f_halves, f_years, f_ex_top_days.
  • Model: two_stage — One-day hold (H = 1, no position policy), SPY/GLD/TLT factor sets on the original 2008 window, specified after validation was seen; validation results are a logged deviation, judge on OOS only. Hard filters disabled at the user's request (reported, not applied)..
  • Deflated Sharpe ratio (N = 165,600 configs tried on this data): 0.000; placebo percentile 84.7; sign-flip Sharpe -0.35; bootstrap 95% CI [-0.28, 0.84].
  • Walk-forward of the selection rule 2011–2021: stitched net Sharpe -0.10, 7 distinct configs in 11 years (red flag: True).
  • Frozen 2026-10-22T22:54:35+00:00 at commit 842933f7ab (dirty: True); data gold_etf_factor_regression.xlsx sha256 4aa64eee1a96….

All returns are daily GDX excess returns on 1x notional (self-financing overlay), net of 2 bps per unit traded unless stated. Signals are formed and executed at the close of day t. Development 2008-05-27 → 2016-12-30, validation 2017-01-03 → 2021-12-31.

Is the edge concentrated on day 1?

At the primary's k=1.25: cumulative edge after day 1 is +17.4 bps (dev) / -8.3 bps (val); after day 2 +36.1 / -25.2 bps; after day 10 -32.7 / -34.0 bps. The day-1 concentration hypothesis is not supported: the edge is small on day 1 and peaks around day 2 in development, then decays.
